findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "guide_music_intent" is 727 chars, far longer than this server's median (77). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Use when someone says what they need their music to help them do next: focus or get into deep work, get ready for a game, workout, meeting or performance, reset…

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_chrp_use_cases" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get public CHRP use-case pages." → after: "Get public CHRP use cases and where to experience CHRP: solution pages, churches, the organization demo, MyCHRP (individuals) and the Song Analyzer (artists)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
